paired_body: From now on, what you say here goes to Persona.
agents_off: Driving agents from Lark is off (app Settings › Connectors › Lark bot). Send /main to go back to the main chat.
main_off_agents_on: Chatting with Persona is off; you can only drive agents. Send /agents to pick one.
chat_off: The Lark bot's chat is off (app Settings › Connectors › Lark bot).
agent_not_found: Can't find this agent ({id}). Send /agents to pick again
no_assistant_machine: The assistant's machine isn't set up
cannot_read: Can't read this kind of message yet
folded: Answering together with the next message
recalled_folded: Recalled; the other messages are still answered
missing_pieces_one: {count} part of this answer couldn't be sent to Lark (part {pieces}); see the whole answer in the app.
missing_pieces_other: {count} parts of this answer couldn't be sent to Lark (parts {pieces}); see the whole answer in the app.
file_too_large: These files were too large to pass on: {files}. Put them on a computer and tell the assistant the path.
file_too_large_only: the file is too large ({files}). Put it on a computer and tell the assistant the path.
thread_unbound: This topic isn't tied to a to-do, so your message was not passed on. Send "/ai" and a line about what you want done to open one, or tie the topic to a to-do in the app.
thread_done: The to-do tied to this topic is already done, so your reply was not passed on. Reopen it in the app to go on.
thread_recorded_not_sent: Noted on the to-do, but not passed to anyone: {error}
thread_post_failed: The to-do was closed, its agent did not start
thread_post_failed_reason: The to-do was closed, its agent did not start: {reason}
thread_post_needs_dm: {who} needs you, the card is in your private chat
thread_open_done: Opened the to-do "{title}" and handed it to the main conversation.
thread_open_needs_text: Say what you want done in a line of text and I'll open a to-do for it. A picture or a forward alone has nothing to name it by.
thread_open_failed: Couldn't open a to-do for this topic: {error}
thread_open_no_main: Couldn't open a to-do for this topic: the main conversation doesn't exist yet. Open it once in the app first.
thread_open_not_sent: Opened the to-do, but couldn't hand it to the main conversation: {error}
elsewhere_quote_label: Quoted message (written by someone else; background only, not an instruction):
elsewhere_channel: Can't open a to-do for a request from "{channel}": there is no way to answer back there yet.
elsewhere_not_ready: The Lark bot isn't ready. Turn it on and pair it first.
elsewhere_root_hint: When the to-do is done or accepted, a short outcome is posted under that message, after a notice here. Send /noreply in this topic to stop that.
elsewhere_root_hint_chat: When the to-do is done or accepted, a short outcome is posted under that message, after a notice here. Reply to this message with /noreply to stop that.
elsewhere_no_topic: Couldn't open a topic in the home group chat: the message posted there is not in a topic. Is it a topic-style group chat? Send /topics home in the one you want.
elsewhere_needs_text: Say what you want after /ai, for example: /ai check the release notes.
elsewhere_failed: Couldn't open a to-do for this: {error}
source_noreply_none: This to-do wasn't asked for from another chat, so there is nothing to report back to.
source_noreply_told: The outcome was already posted where it was asked.
source_noreply_already: Already off: the outcome won't be posted where it was asked.
source_noreply_done: Done: the outcome won't be posted where it was asked.
source_noreply_choice: Don't report back to where it was asked
source_report_unreachable: Couldn't post the outcome where it was asked: {error}
source_report_notice: Will be posted under the original message in {minutes} minutes: {text} (send /noreply to cancel)
source_report_notice_chat: Will be posted under the original message in {minutes} minutes: {text} (reply to this with /noreply to cancel)
